newsitem.title: USA: Toyota sees higher U.S. sales in '97.
newsitem.headline: Toyota sees higher U.S. sales in '97.

text.p: Toyota Motor Corp expects 1997 sales in the United States to top the 1,070,000 it sold in 1996, Dave Illingworth, senior vice president of Toyota Motor Sales USA Inc said Wednesday.

"We're anticipating 1997 will be our fourth year in a row of an all-time record sales year," Illingworth said at the North American International Auto Show here, where Toyota introduced its new 1998 Sienna minivan. Toyota expects to sell 50,000 to 60,000 units of the new minivan, a front-wheel drive vehicle built off a longer version of the Camry platform, Illingworth said at a press conference.
